purpose: One-complex Boltz-2 cofolding, pose, and pipeline-observability test

protein.name: Human galectin-3 carbohydrate-recognition domain
protein.construct_notes: Exact canonical sequence for deposited polymer entity 1; RCSB reports no mutation and complete modeling of all 139 deposited residues.

ligand.name: beta-D-galactopyranose
ligand.stereochemistry: beta-D-galactopyranose, preserved explicitly in the RCSB CCD stereochemical SMILES
ligand.representation_notes: SMILES_stereo copied from RCSB CCD GAL. The anomer and stereocenters must not be replaced by an unspecified galactose representation.

limitations: No matched quantitative affinity measurement is available, so affinity accuracy cannot be evaluated.
The crystal confirms binding but does not define Boltz-2's binary-head training label for this sample.
One complex cannot estimate ranking, calibration, or generalization.
A post-model PDB release lowers direct coordinate-leakage risk but does not prove complete independence from all related structures or sequences.
The deposited entry also contains carbohydrate and crystallization components that are excluded from the model input; only one beta-D-galactose molecule is modeled.
